description: Raid embed displays attendance in 3-column layout (Tank/Heal/DPS)
steps: Create a raid with `/raid create`
Verify the embed shows Tank column on left
Verify Healer column in middle
Verify DPS (Melee + Ranged combined) on right
Verify each column shows role count and sorted player names
Verify late/opted-out users appear in separate sections below columns

description: Late players display in dedicated section below main columns
steps: Create a raid with multiple members
Click 'Running Late' button as a player
Verify player moves to 'Running Late' section
Verify section appears below Tank/Heal/DPS columns
Verify late section shows count and player names

description: Opted-out players display in dedicated section
steps: Create a raid with multiple members
Click 'Opt Out' button as a player
Verify player moves to 'Opted Out' section
Verify section appears below Tank/Heal/DPS columns
Verify opted-out section shows count and player names

description: Players with no class set display in separate category
steps: Create a raid with a new member (no class set)
Verify member appears in 'No Class' section
Verify 'No Class' section appears below main columns
Click member selects class/spec
Verify member moves to appropriate role column

description: /raid refresh command updates raid with new eligible members
steps: Create a raid with current raid role members
Add a new Discord member to the raid role (outside bot)
Run `/raid refresh raid_id:xyz`
Verify new member is added to raid attendance
Verify embed message updates to show new member
Create a raid with 5 members
Remove raid role from one member (outside bot)
Run `/raid refresh raid_id:xyz`
Verify removed member is deleted from raid attendance
Verify embed message updates immediately

description: /raid refresh command refreshes embed design changes
steps: Create a raid
Modify column layout or styling in code
Run `/raid refresh raid_id:xyz`
Verify embed message updates with new design
Verify all players still displayed correctly

description: /raid create accepts optional roles parameter for custom roster
steps: Run `/raid create date:2026-01-20 time:20:00 title:Custom Raid roles:CustomRole1,CustomRole2`
Verify only members with CustomRole1 or CustomRole2 are added
Verify configured raid roles are NOT used
Verify raid is created successfully with custom roster

description: /raid create without roles parameter uses configured raid roles
steps: Configure raid roles with `/config raid-roles roles:Raider,Member`
Run `/raid create date:2026-01-20 time:20:00 title:Standard Raid` (no roles param)
Verify members with Raider or Member role are added
Verify custom roles parameter was not needed

Find command documentation section
